title: Default Admin sidebar does not open from an Inline Form Errors link
description: Replay the narrow-window Article form flow: open the advanced sidebar, set an invalid URL alias, close the sidebar, save, then use the 'URL alias' link in the error summary. Both sides must reach the same error-summary state; the assertion under test is that the sidebar opens and the invalid field receives focus. Real clicks are used: the pinned evidence found that script-generated clicks do not trigger the focus behaviour.
preconditions: Default Admin is the admin theme, the Path module is on, the Article content type exists, and Inline Form Errors is enabled (recipe ife_sidebar_repro).
Variant 3619127-pinned is built: Before envs/baseline-main, After envs/issue-3619127-vanilla (MR !16895 plus patch-0 no jQuery and patch-1 no-persist).
The viewport is narrow (480x900 in the evaluator) so the advanced-fields sidebar starts collapsed.

fixture.notes: recipes/ife_sidebar_repro/ exists and is the recipe named by variant 3619127-pinned. It sets up Default Admin, the Article content type with Path, and Inline Form Errors.

steps.label: Open the Add Article form in a narrow window
The Article form is loaded with the sidebar collapsed
Open the URL alias details section
Wait for the URL alias section to be open
Enter an invalid URL alias (no leading slash)
Save the article and wait for the validation error
Wait for the error summary link to the URL alias field
The error summary links to the URL alias field
Use the URL alias error link with a real click
Wait for the message region to remain (do not wait for the field: Before never shows it)
State after using the URL alias error link
The sidebar opened and the invalid URL alias field has focus

checkpoints.label: The Article form is loaded with the sidebar collapsed
The error summary links to the URL alias field
State after using the URL alias error link

resetInstructions: node scripts/lab-env.mjs reset 3619127-pinned --yes (the save is rejected, but a reset clears the draft and the saved sidebar preference)
manualReview: Repeat the final step with the keyboard only (Tab to the error link, press Enter) and confirm the sidebar opens and focus moves to the field; the pinned evidence found that script-generated clicks do not trigger the focus behaviour, so a person's keyboard pass is the confirmatory check.
Confirm the page does not scroll away and the field is not hidden behind sticky UI.
Confirm the user's saved sidebar preference is not overwritten: reload the form after the flow and check the sidebar returns to the state the user last chose.
Press Enter on the same error link a second time and check it still works.
A real screen-reader pass on the error summary and the field.
limits: Only the error-summary link path is covered; the other error-summary and sidebar combinations (Authoring information, other validation errors) are not.

The exact trigger accessible name is the label Default Admin renders ('Hide sidebar panel' on the initial narrow state, from core/themes/default_admin/src/Hook/FormHooks.php); if the theme label changes the locator needs updating.
The URL alias details summary is reached with a CSS selector because <summary> has no Playwright role mapping.
The scenario has not been replayed in this session; no Drupal site was running.
notes: Read reports/issues/3619127/EVIDENCE.md, REPRODUCE.md, the registered variant 3619127-pinned and tools/playwright/evaluate-3619127.mjs. The flow, the 480x900 viewport, the error-link selector a[href$="#edit-path-0-alias"], the URL alias field name and the real-click requirement come from that evaluator and the pinned evidence. The trigger markup and its 'Hide sidebar panel' label come from core/themes/default_admin/src/Hook/FormHooks.php and migration/js/sidebar.js in envs/issue-3619127-vanilla. Inferred, not observed: that getByRole('button') resolves the anchor trigger, and that focus lands on the textbox named 'URL alias'. Not run: no Drupal site was running in this session.
